doctrine.title: Meta Ads Operating Doctrine (Consolidated)
doctrine.summary: Full-funnel Meta/Facebook advertising framework synthesized from 20 segments covering campaign architecture, creative validation, audience strategy, and partnership-ad leverage. Strongest signal: creative accounts for 70-80% of results; problem-first copy; frequency monitoring; partnership-ad warm-audience pre-seeding.

campaign_architecture.structure: 3-tier: Campaign (objective + budget + strategy) > Ad Set (audience + targeting + performance goal) > Ad (creative + copy + CTA)
campaign_architecture.objective_selection: Beginners: Leads or Sales. Objective selection + performance goal alignment is the single load-bearing decision; wrong goal contradicts the objective and corrupts ML optimization.
campaign_architecture.budget_rule: Set daily budgets you can afford to lose entirely. Never over-constrain.
campaign_architecture.performance_goal_alignment: Performance goal must match campaign objective exactly. Misalignment sends conflicting signals to Meta's ML.

audience_strategy.location: Advertise only where customers are; trust Meta to expand beyond stated criteria.
audience_strategy.targeting_constraint: Custom audiences in the 'suggest' section are soft constraints, not hard blocks. Let Meta expand.
audience_strategy.audience_network_economics: Platform takes 30%; publisher gets 70%. Factor into CPM expectations.
audience_strategy.warm_audience_pre_seeding: Partnership-ad / creator account access gives warm audience reach before a campaign launches. Use this as a cold-start accelerant.

creative_validation.creative_weight: Creative drives 70-80% of campaign results. Prioritize creative testing above all other variables.
creative_validation.copy_pattern: Problem + Feature + Benefit + Scarcity + CTA in 2-3 sentences.
creative_validation.test_volume: Run up to 5 copy variations and 5 headline variations simultaneously.
creative_validation.creative_mining: One strong testimonial can yield 100+ ad variations (kale gym case study: single testimonial reskinned across angles, hooks, formats).
creative_validation.problem_first: Lead with the audience's problem before any feature or benefit claim.
creative_validation.frequency_monitoring: Watch frequency closely; creative fatigue degrades performance faster than any targeting issue.

benchmarks.roas: Track ROAS as primary return signal; CPM and CTR are diagnostic, not primary.
benchmarks.cpm_ctr: Use CPM/CTR to isolate creative vs. audience problems: high CPM + low CTR = creative failure; low CPM + low CTR = audience mismatch.
benchmarks.note: Specific numeric thresholds vary by vertical; treat published benchmarks as directional, not universal.

partnership_ads.mechanism: Request creator account access; run ads from their handle to inherit warm audience trust.
partnership_ads.data_leverage: Partnership ad data feeds back into your pixel; use it to build lookalikes from validated warm signals.

gates_and_decision_rules: Gate 1: Objective set before budget. Never set budget without confirming objective is correct.
Gate 2: Performance goal reviewed against objective before launch.
Gate 3: Audience constraint audit: remove unnecessary exclusions before activating.
Gate 4: Creative minimum: at least 3 variations live before reading results.
Gate 5: Frequency check at day 5 and day 10 of any active campaign.
Gate 6: Partnership-ad eligibility check before cold-start on any new audience.
excluded_as_non_sniped_relevant: E-commerce cold-start tutorials (product catalog, Shopify pixel setup)
UI navigation walk-throughs and timestamp filler
Hindi-language segment specifics beyond partnership-ad concept
Productivity/momentum system content (no connection to ad operations)

notes: Source is a mixed-source tutorial compendium (YouTube educators, multiple speakers, some Hindi-language content). Framework is commoditized but solid. Strongest unique yield: creative-validation methodology and partnership-ad warm-audience leverage. Duplicated concept coverage across segments 11-16 and 18 stripped. No SNIPED-specific application without a live ad campaign; file should be consulted when SNIPED runs paid social, not during organic-only phases.
